doc: Offline processing package for the SHM displacement project.
Utility scripts package for offline processing.  Exports: - `interp_to_master`: interpolate time series to a uniform timeline. - `rts_smooth`: Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoother for CV model.

Compute synchronization and accuracy metrics between camera-derived displacement and reference LDV (optional). Also produces basic quality stats.  Usage:     python compute_metrics.py         --cam_csv /data/export_run1/fused_disp.csv         --ldv_csv /data/e
